title: The Spacecraft Lost to a Unit Label
summary: In 1999 NASA's Mars Climate Orbiter burned up at Mars because ground software reported thruster data in pound-seconds instead of newton-seconds.

fields.delivery: with calm, procedural restraint, building quiet dread and then dry disbelief
